name: kvm-automation
title_zh: 隔着屏幕按键盘的远程手，专治没 SSH 的裸机
tagline_zh: BIOS 卡住、系统装一半、登录锁死——只要还有画面和 USB 口，就能截屏、敲键、粘贴、点鼠标。
tagline_en: BIOS stuck, install half-done, login locked—if it has HDMI and USB, you can screenshot, type, paste, and click.
desc_en: Drive a physical computer through an IP-KVM (GLKVM, PiKVM, or TinyPilot) using the kvm_* MCP tools - screenshot, keystroke, paste, mouse, wait. Use when the target machine has no SSH or in-band agent and only HDMI pixels plus USB HID are available - installs, recovery, BIOS, first boot, locked machines.
why_zh: 不是模拟器，是真 IP-KVM 硬件通道。像素级截图 + HID 注入。
why_en: Real IP-KVM hardware path, not emulation. Pixel-accurate screenshots plus HID injection—lower than any in-band agent, so it even.
limit_zh: 只认 GLKVM、PiKVM、TinyPilot 三种设备；目标机必须有 HDMI 输出和 USB 口。
limit_en: Only GLKVM, PiKVM, or TinyPilot. Target needs HDMI out and USB in. Blind typing fails without video; you must wait and verify screen before each.
title_en: Remote hands for machines with no SSH, only HDMI
